key_findings: Intrathecal daphnetin relieved TNF-alpha-induced neuropathic pain in rats and suppressed spinal IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha.
Daphnetin reduced CXCL13/CXCR5 and CX3CL1/CX3CR1/CatS and shifted glia from A1/M1 toward A2/M2 phenotypes.
